reason: AFG underwrites specialty commercial property and casualty insurance for businesses, sold through agents and brokers. Security National has three segments: life insurance and pre-need funeral products, funeral and cemetery services, and residential mortgage lending. Both are regulated insurers earning premium and investment income. But the products (P&C vs life/final-expense, plus mortgage and mortuary operations) and the customers (commercial policyholders vs individual consumers, home buyers and funeral clients) do not overlap.
reason_if_0: Different industry / different customers: commercial specialty P&C underwriter vs a diversified life insurance, funeral and mortgage business serving consumers. The only shared trait is being an insurance carrier.
